## radio

| Setting | Type | Unit | Default | Range or choices | Level | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <span id="s-scale-radio-follows"></span>`scale.radio.follows` | boolean | | | recommended On, unless radio.tiers.focus names its own region. | advanced | :material-check-circle:{ title="Active" } `wired` | Whether the radio's focus region is the microscopic region: the declared tiers inside it and the abstract propagation tier outside. Ignored when `radio.tiers.focus` names a region of its own. Whether the radio's detailed region is the traffic's detailed box, so radios outside it use the cheap abstract model. |
| <span id="s-scale-radio-margin-m"></span>`scale.radio.margin_m` | number | m | | [0, ∞)<br>recommended Leave unset (the radio's own range, about 300 m for DSRC); 100 to 1000 m. | advanced | :material-check-circle:{ title="Active" } `wired` | How far outside the microscopic region a vehicle's radio stays on, metres; past it a vehicle in the queue network neither transmits nor receives. Absent, the radio's own reach (`radio.range`). How far outside the detailed box a queued vehicle's radio stays on; beyond it, it neither sends nor hears. |
| <span id="s-scale-radio-receive-in-margin"></span>`scale.radio.receive_in_margin` | boolean | | | recommended Off for speed; on when receivers outside the box matter to the study. | advanced | :material-check-circle:{ title="Active" } `wired` | Whether a vehicle in the margin (queued, within `margin_m` of the region) is also a receiver. Off, it only transmits: the region hears it, and its own receptions — most of a city's reception work — are not evaluated. Whether queued vehicles near the box also receive messages, not only send them; on costs most of a city's reception work. |
